question.html: In a double-slit experiment monochromatic light of wavelength nm is incident on two slits that are at a distance of m from a screen. The separation of the slits is mm. The distance between the central maximum and the first minimum in the interference pattern that forms on the screen is . What is the new distance between the central maximum and the first minimum in the interference pattern when the wavelength, the distance between the slits and the screen, and the slit separation are all halved?
